config.voxyworldgenv2.title: Voxy World Gen V2 Config
config.voxyworldgenv2.option.enabled.too: Completely enable or disable the mod's generation logic.
config.voxyworldgenv2.option.f3_stats.to: Show generation statistics in the F3 debug menu.
config.voxyworldgenv2.option.radius.tool: The radius (in chunks) around players to generate.
config.voxyworldgenv2.option.update_inte: How often to scan for new ungenerated chunks.
config.voxyworldgenv2.option.max_queue.t: Maximum number of chunks to keep in the pending queue.
Maximum number of chunks generating simultaneously.
config.voxyworldgenv2.option.gen_rate.to: Caps how many chunks the generation worker starts per second. 0 = unlimited. Lower this if generation hurts FPS or TPS.
Use a separate, unthrottled settings profile in singleplayer and LAN worlds. When off, the General settings and limits apply there too. This never lowers your General values - the profile's Auto values only raise them.
config.voxyworldgenv2.option.sp_radius.t: Generation radius (chunks) in singleplayer. 0 = Auto: the larger of 128 and your General radius.
config.voxyworldgenv2.option.sp_tasks.to: Parallel generation tasks in singleplayer. 0 = Auto: the larger of 128 and your General value.
config.voxyworldgenv2.option.sp_rate.too: LOD bandwidth cap in singleplayer. 0 = unlimited (recommended - it is your own machine).
config.voxyworldgenv2.option.sp_gen_rate: Caps generation speed in singleplayer. 0 = unlimited. Set this if background generation drains your FPS.
config.voxyworldgenv2.option.sp_pause.to: Seconds to pause background generation after a dimension change in singleplayer. 0 = no pause.
